text:
Type: wooden dining chair
Use: dining; dining room, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, farmhouse, minimalist
Materials: solid wood in a black stain
Colors: black, dark charcoal
Shape: wide curved backrest panel between two posts, armless, thick flat wooden seat with an apron, square legs with low side stretchers, simple and sturdy, compact
Feel: sturdy, honest, calm, simple
Goes with: wood or black tables, white walls, warm textiles; Scandinavian, farmhouse or industrial kitchens
